phase9_centralized.model: Centralized Random Forest Only (rf_8class_b2.joblib, 200 trees, no XGBoost)

phase11_baseline.verified_cause: Different model version and ensemble weighting: Phase 3 manifest records the SMOTE-trained baseline ensemble with weights RF 0.20 + XGBoost 0.80 (models/rf_8class_baseline.joblib, models/xgb_8class_baseline.joblib), which reproduces the manifest accuracy of 0.9553 and macro F1 of 0.8766 exactly. Phase 11 benchmarks the B2 model version trained without SMOTE with balanced class weighting (models/rf_8class_b2.joblib, models/xgb_8class_b2.joblib) wired with weights RF 0.60 + XGBoost 0.40, yielding 0.9542 accuracy (-0.0011 difference).
